note: Counted from the run's per-PDF records, with each URL replaced by its SHA-256 and a flag for whether it had a space (pdfs-public.jsonl, not published: it keeps the PDF software strings, which were not checked for personal names). 'with_space' means the link as written on the page contained a space. 0.2.0 failed on every such link; 0.2.1 encodes them. Many of the 404s with a space come from pages that set <base href>, which 0.2.1 ignored; 0.2.2 follows it.
